title: openHAB Item Update State Value Leaderboard
dataSources: Home Assistant state/logbook events (`homeassistant:event`), Homey flow/insights (`homey:flow`), SmartThings events (`smartthings:event`), Hubitat/openHAB logs, Node-RED flow events (`nodered:event`).
app: Home Assistant / Homey / SmartThings / Hubitat / openHAB event streams via MQTT, webhooks, and REST — forwarded to Splunk HEC.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=openhab:event state_value=*
| stats sum(state_value) as total_value, avg(state_value) as avg_value by item_name
| sort - total_value
description: Ranks item values by total and average state value across openHAB item update events.
value: Leaderboards help you see which people, devices, places, or projects dominate the signal.
implementation: Ingest numeric `state_value` values for each openHAB item update event and review total and average state value by item.
visualization: Table of entities ranked by total state value.
grandmaExplanation: It notes which item shows the biggest state value numbers in your openHAB item update data.
